repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-wdm
repository.purpose: Deprecated alias package of the Webex JS SDK: keeps the historical @webex/internal-plugin-wdm import path working by re-exporting the Device plugin and its config, constants, interceptor, and feature classes from @webex/internal-plugin-device.

task_playbooks.when_to_use: Changing the re-exports in src/index.js or the package entry points in package.json.
task_playbooks.fallback: If the alias must gain behavior, stop: behavior belongs in @webex/internal-plugin-device. Report the conflict instead of adding logic here.

task_playbooks.when_to_use: Code changes alter a requirement, the public surface, a dependency, or a pitfall documented in the module spec.

task_playbooks.fallback: Leave generated metadata and validation status untouched; validation is run by an independent runtime.

glossary.definition: Web device manager: the Webex service that stores device registrations.
glossary.notes: This package is named after it; registration behavior lives in the device package.

glossary.definition: This package: it re-exports the device plugin and adds no behavior.
The internal plugin device exposed as webex.internal.device, implemented in @webex/internal-plugin-device.

evidence_rules.requirement: Cite only a script defined in package.json; the test script references test:integration, which package.json does not define.
State a behavior only when src/index.js implements it or the device package specification states it; call it tested only when a test invokes it (the unit test asserts true and does not count).
Document an export only if src/index.js exports it.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not use commit or pull-request history as evidence for why behavior exists.
negative_guidance.why: The package owner directed that the codebase, not git history, is the evidence source.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not document registration, refresh, or feature behavior here.
negative_guidance.why: That behavior is owned by @webex/internal-plugin-device and specified in its module specification.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not document webex.internal.wdm as available.
negative_guidance.why: No code in the monorepo registers a plugin named wdm.

high.expectation: Source and a behavioral test both confirm the claim.

medium.expectation: Only source confirms the claim; state the missing test as a gap.

low.expectation: Neither source nor test confirms it; report the gap instead of documenting it.
